title: Adapter
description: Creates a type:adapter library with a port implementation skeleton and, with --confine, the third-party confinement row.

name.description: Adapter name; adapter- is added when missing (adapter-demo or demo).

port.description: The port interface this adapter implements, PascalCase (for example DemoPort).

confine.description: Comma-separated npm packages that only this adapter may import. Adds a row to the confinement table in eslint.config.mjs; the package must also pass the supply-chain allow-list.

description.description: One or two sentences for the README purpose section.

trustCritical.description: Adds trust:critical (net-dialer-like adapters that need CODEOWNERS sign-off).
